fire_01.jpg.comment: Night shot of a hillside fire above dark water (a lake or the sea, not a flood), a gantry or sign structure and light trails in the foreground. No house is visible.

flood_01.jpg.comment: Brown water in a town square up to the ground floors of intact buildings, traffic signs, no people visible.

structural_01.jpg.comment: Partly collapsed house with rubble and timber in front, cropped to remove people. Whether dust is visible in the air is unclear to me, so it is not scored.

edge_02_conflict.jpg.comment: Backyard with fence, shed, trees, a pole with wires and a hazy orange sun. No water on the ground, no road. Haze is from smoke (the photo is titled forest fire smoke).

fire_02.jpg.report_text: Heavy smoke is rising behind a farm and a house stands close to the smoke. We think a wildfire is coming toward the house.
fire_02.jpg.comment: Smoke columns over fields, one house at the bottom right. No flames are visible, so flames are not required and not scored.

fire_03.jpg.report_text: A large smoke column over the fields, probably a grass fire. Nobody is nearby.
fire_03.jpg.comment: Smoke only, over a field with a fence. No flames visible.

fire_04_house.jpg.report_text: A house is on fire in our street. Flames are coming out of the roof and the front door.
fire_04_house.jpg.comment: Structure fire. Structural damage is plausible (burning roof) so it is not scored.

fire_05_training.jpg.report_text: A building is burning and firefighters are working on it.
fire_05_training.jpg.comment: House fire with firefighters far away. The title says training burn; the picture alone cannot show that.

edge_04_blurred_water.jpg.report_text: Flooding in the city centre. The whole square is under water.
edge_04_blurred_water.jpg.comment: Blurred night photo of a lit building and its reflection in still water. It is not a flood: a good answer flags the blur and the dark, and does not confirm the report. Water as such is visible, so flood_water is not scored.

flood_03_satellite.jpg.report_text: The river has overflowed and flooded the fields and part of the city.
flood_03_satellite.jpg.comment: Two satellite panels. White clouds in the lower panel are not smoke. Place names are printed in the image.

structural_02.jpg.report_text: A brick building partly collapsed after the earthquake. Bricks are lying across the street.
structural_02.jpg.comment: Damaged upper corner, boarded openings, pile of bricks. People in the far background, if any, are not scored.

control_01_night.jpg.report_text: A big fire is burning on this street tonight.
control_01_night.jpg.comment: Calm night street, lamps lit, no disaster, low light. A good answer does not confirm the report.
